workflow.name: archon-deliver
workflow.description:
The delivery tail, autonomous on its green path: capped rounds of implement, draft
PR, review, simplify and one CI agent that marks the PR ready on green
(archon-deliver-block). When the rounds end not ready, whether they ran out, a
review asked for a replan or a person, or CI stayed red, the run pauses as one
attention item instead of ending with nothing to take it forward. The answer
delivers another capped batch of rounds with the person's note, or ends the run
with the outcome as it stands. Merging stays on the forge, outside the run.

Use when: decided work should become a reviewed, ready-to-merge PR —
"deliver this plan", "take this to a PR", "build and ship this".
NOT for: deciding what to build, or merging (always human).

pull_request.description: The number of an open pull request this delivery continues instead of opening one, as a caller resolved it. Empty or `null` when the caller names none; the run can still continue one it was launched onto.

branch.description: The branch a new pull request opens from, as the caller resolved it. When an open pull request already has that head, the push updates it instead of opening another. Empty opens it from the checkout's branch.

work.description: What to deliver — a plan path, findings, a description, or the repair of an existing pull request when this run was launched on its branch (`--adopt`, or from the pull request). Empty means the run's trigger message is the work.

part.description: The part of an approved multi-part plan this delivery is, forwarded unchanged to every review in the rounds. archon-review's `part` input owns its shape. Empty delivers the whole contract.

errors.description: Silent-failure lens — auto, true, or false.
